_CREDIT_FORMAT.no_songselect_entry: - "Title" (Artist) — performed live by our praise team; songwriter and publisher information not listed in SongSelect
_CREDIT_FORMAT.RULE: NEVER write 'performed live under our church license' for a song with no SongSelect entry. CCLI coverage only extends to songs in the Covered Catalogs; asserting coverage for a song that isn't in them is a claim we cannot support. State the facts, claim nothing.
_CREDIT_FORMAT.NEVER_USE_HASH: YouTube linkifies '#12345' and shows the first hashtags ABOVE the video title. Writing 'CCLI Song #5911299' put the CCLI numbers where #GloryNight should be — confirmed live on the Aug 17 2026 stream. Always write 'No.', never '#', for any CCLI number.

_PARTIAL_NEEDS_COPYRIGHT._RULE: These have a CCLI number and authors but no verified copyright line, so assemble_desc.py must NOT emit them — a credit without the (c) owner is incomplete under CCLI's format. Finish them on a signed-in SongSelect session, then move each into the main bank.
